once12: Generate the effect once. Perform it again with your voice.
size12: A quiet puff plays small. A loud boom plays big.
ltx12: LTX two point five, with the fluid LoRA, makes this fire in Comfy UI.
sdk12: The app sends this workflow to Comfy UI through the Comfy Python SDK.
how12: Track the hand. Mask it, and add the firelight.
scene12: Each hit lights the next lantern in turn.
new12: My contribution is separating generation from performance: one LTX effect from Comfy UI becomes a reusable instrument. Your voice controls when it hits and how big it plays, without another AI generation.
try12: Try the included LTX effect on your laptop, no GPU needed.
